Nene recommends

Haenggung-dong local picks

Places we somehow drift into on a walk, places we always bring guests, and old shops where Haenggung-dong time has settled layer by layer. In a neighborhood full of 30-, 40-, and 50-year stories, we gathered only the regular spots we genuinely love.

From Haenggung-dong, Nene & Minho

Meals

01 Korean · Tteokbokki

이도경 떡볶이 Yidokyeong Tteokbokki

Our go-to order is "classic tteokbokki + jjolmyeon noodles + assorted fried bites (+ seaweed roll) + fried rice" :) The sauce is deliciously spicy. Even the mild version has a proper kick.

The fried bits taste clean, with none of that heavy oil smell, and the batter stays light and crackly. The fried rice uses good rice (the secret is mud-snail rice!), so even after soaking up the sauce, every grain stays springy instead of turning mushy.

The woman who runs the place has her name on the tteokbokki and sells it with real pride. She is adorable.

Naver Map

02 Korean · Grilled beef

예박사 Yebaksa

A great-value grilled meat spot. Instead of splurging on famous Suwon galbi, you can eat fresh, tasty beef rib meat at a sensible price.

It started in a scruffy market alley, selling meat and scallion salad from plastic tubs, with customers grilling outside on bathhouse stools. Now they have a proper building. Many Suwon locals, including me, watched that glow-up happen in real time.

Here is the little market-street success story we love to introduce :D

Naver Map

03 Korean · Gopchang

입주집 Ipjujip

A grilled gopchang institution with over 50 years behind it! They source good product through trusted suppliers built up over decades. Clean, fresh gopchang, daechang, makchang, and even heart.

You can also order beef spinal cord, a true specialty among specialty cuts. It goes bad so quickly that even carrying it is proof the turnover and freshness are serious. That is possible because regulars and new guests keep the tables moving.

When the weather turns chilly, the gopchang hot pot is also highly, highly recommended :)

Naver Map

04 Korean · Salt-grilled pork

대길소금구이 Daegil Sogeumgui

For more than 30 years, this place has carried the pride of Suwon-style salt-grilled pork.

Please, please try the fresh pork neck grilled with salt. It eats almost like pork belly, but one bite tells you it is different. They grill and cut it for you, so your only job is to enjoy. Their signature dipping sauce adds the kick, though I just go with salt because the meat is that fresh and tender.

Nene also loved the grilled heart and pork skin. The skin in particular looks unlike anything we have seen elsewhere, so check it out :) The side dishes are generous and clean. Finish with rice mixed into doenjang stew, or slurp some bibim noodles and you will understand.

Naver Map

05 Korean · Pyongyang naengmyeon

평장원 Pyeongjangwon

One of Suwon's representative Pyongyang naengmyeon restaurants! Their version is gentle enough for everyone to enjoy. Everything is tidy and tasty, so this is where we go when we want to treat someone to a proper meal. Order a spread and share it around, and it feels like a small feast :)

Nene is actually a serious dumpling person, and eating Pyeongjangwon's mandu hot pot in winter is one of her seasonal joys.

Try it in the charming hanok-converted space, watching snow drift outside while you sip the dumpling broth.

Naver Map

06 Korean · Kalguksu

대왕칼국수 Daewang Kalguksu

A country-style kalguksu spot with 50 years of history. Strongly recommended for noodle people! First of all, the portion is massive for the price. A regular bowl for 6,000 won... is this real life? For many women, one bowl is a bit of a climb, so wear stretchy pants.

The regular and extra-large bowls cost the same, but the extra-large comes with an egg. Choose that if you want the protein.

The broth tastes so mild that at first you may think, "Why is this so quiet...?" but then it sneaks up on you. It is like the Pyongyang naengmyeon of kalguksu. Help yourself to as much kkakdugi and sour kimchi as you want. The summer-only kongguksu is also a hit!

Naver Map

07 Korean · Home cooking

골목집 Golmokjip

The moment the tasty side dishes land, it feels warm, like eating at home. Their aged-kimchi braised dish, simmered until everything turns soft and deep, is a full-on rice thief.

It was featured in Huh Young-man's Sikgaek, so for a while it was nearly impossible to get a seat. It has long been used like a neighborhood elders' gathering room, so the place is loud, lively, and full of energy.

The spicy pork, stir-fried squid, and gochujang stew are all good. We confidently recommend it when you want a Korean home-style meal.

Naver Map

08 Korean · Seafood

서문수산 Seomun Susan

One of Nene's favorite sashimi spots. They recommend whatever is best in season, so it is hard to miss. It is also close to home, which makes it a perfect walkable neighborhood favorite.

Trust the owner's family, who have run it for over 20 years, and just try it once! Maybe because they also operate in the seafood market auction scene, even the basic seafood is incredibly fresh. If they got friends who disliked seafood into sea cucumber and sea squirt, that says plenty, right?

Nene's favorite is mackerel sashimi! If it is available, order it without hesitation. Hesitating only wastes time. A very strong recommendation. Double thumbs up!

Naver Map

09 Korean · Ssam-bap / sashimi

시골집 우렁이쌈밥 Sigoljip Ureongi Ssam-bap

The owner originally ran a sashimi restaurant for a long time, then switched to ssam-bap to work a little more gently. But the old regulars asked for sashimi again so much that it came back. Now it almost feels like the side business became the main thing...?

The all-you-can-eat sashimi menu is reservation-only, and the fish changes by season, so call ahead before going. Prices vary by fish, too.

We make sure to stop by during yellowtail season. The knife work is excellent, the aging is spot-on, and the slices are thick enough to fill your mouth in the best way. The ssam-bap is also well composed and tasty, so it is an easy Korean meal recommendation.

Naver Map

10 Western · Bakery

미트테일 Meat Tale

A view restaurant in every sense, looking down over Hwaseong Haenggung.

Their inexpensive meat pies are great as a snack and filling enough for a light meal. The house-made pastrami sandwich, jambon pizza, and ciabatta with various toppings were all good, so take a look around :)

On a nice day, the rooftop seats are the move!

Naver Map

11 Chinese · Dumplings

연밀 Yeonmil

A Northeast Chinese dumpling house run by a Chinese owner from Harbin. It is a dumpling specialist. The juicy soup dumplings and crispy-bottomed binghua dumplings are popular, and personally I love the Spanish mackerel boiled dumplings.

They are serious about developing new dishes, and they keep introducing seasonal or trend-aware menus.

Watching the owner's Korean improve year by year is also a sweet, quietly happy point.

Naver Map

12 Chinese · Old favorite

수원만두 Suwon Mandu

A Taiwanese-style Chinese restaurant with 50 years of tradition. It is good for a casual bowl of beef soup and fried dumplings, or for ordering dishes and making it a big meal.

It is one of the regular places my grandparents kept going to. We also spent time there for family occasions, so it holds a lot of memories.

Order five-spice sliced pork and fried dumplings, then finish with beef noodle soup. That is a very nice course!

Naver Map

Coffee

13 Cafe · Specialty

노스모크 워드아웃 파이어 유림점 No Smoke Without Fire, Yurim

10:30 OPEN · 20:00 LAST ORDER

The second branch of the Suwon coffee brand No Smoke Without Fire, known for specialty coffee. Halfway up Paldalsan, it has a variety of beans and tasty bakery items.

From our house, you can reach it by walking about 25 minutes along the Paldalsan trail! There are plenty of baked goods, so it is great with coffee.

Stop by after walking the Paldalsan trail, where the lives of Haenggung-dong residents are quietly folded in, and a cup of coffee may make you feel almost local.

Naver Map

14 Cafe · Haenggung view

위해브투데이 We Have Today

12:00 OPEN · 20:00 LAST ORDER

A cafe where the view of Hwaseong Haenggung through the wide windows feels open and beautiful.

Less than a five-minute walk from Stay Eego, you can soak up the charm of Hwaseong Haenggung.

It gives you that very full, very Haenggung-dong kind of feeling.

Naver Map

15 Cafe · Jazz

그루비 Groovy

09:00 OPEN · 19:00 CLOSE

A space that somehow gives you nostalgia for something you never even had. A cafe full of deep, weighty wood interiors.

Music by jazz artists I love often plays here, so I feel an instant private closeness to it. Bill Evans, Chet Baker, Miles Davis fit the room perfectly. The mood is good by day and by night.

We recommend the milk tea, French toast, and iced latte. The iced latte uses milk ice, so it does not get watery as you drink. That is the detail...! Enjoy it quietly in a space full of the owner's taste. Note: groups of three or more are not allowed.

Naver Map

16 Cafe · Hand drip

아우토그라프 Autograph

11:00 OPEN · 22:00 CLOSE

The place in Haenggung-dong with the widest range of beans. Try different beans and you realize again how varied coffee can be. Tell them what you like, and they will help you choose.

This is the place that pulled Nene deeper into hand-drip coffee... hehe. Thanks to them, we now buy the day's pick and brew coffee at home.

Recently they opened a second branch in a renovated two-story detached house nearby. It has a different pleasure from the hideout feel of the original. Drinking fragrant hand-drip coffee on the rooftop while looking at the Hwaseong fortress walls is so, so good :-)

Sweets

17 Cake · Mousse

프리히 Freeh

A place specializing in pretty, delicious mousse cakes. They introduce new menus every month with seasonal ingredients.

Their baked sweets are good too. We recommend pairing them with hand-drip coffee!

Naver Map

18 Cake · Lettering

원모어케이크 One More Cake

The number-one lettering cake shop in Haenggung-dong. Their almost machine-perfect lettering turns special days into even more special ones.

The cakes taste good too, so it is a true two-for-one. If you need a cake for a special day, prepare it in advance at One More.

Naver Map

19 Cookies · Scones

파트브리제 Pate Brisee

My mother-in-law's favorite cookie shop. The scones are good.

We recommend everything, but for a first visit, classic is classic! Try the classic financier and classic scone :)

Naver Map

20 Bread · Sourdough

에버닌 Everneen

A diligent neighborhood bakery that makes bread honestly and very well. They use natural yeast, so even though it is flour, your stomach feels comfortable afterward.

Nene's favorite is the 100% whole-wheat sourdough! It is plain and clean, but the more you chew, the nuttier it gets. The blueberry baguette with blueberry cream cheese is also popular.

Honestly though... everything is good. Hehe.

Naver Map

21 Bread · Salt bread

솔트 팩토리 Salt Factory

A new salt bread specialist in Haenggung-dong. You can check Instagram to see when the fresh batches come out.

If you time your visit right, you may meet the ultimate salt bread...? Look forward to a buttery, nutty salt bread in a quiet Haenggung-dong alley.

Naver Map

22 Churros · Injeolmi

츄플러스 Chuplus

From the outside it looks like the churros you have seen everywhere... but maybe a little plumper...? Take a bite and the chewy, injeolmi-like texture becomes addictive. They add glutinous rice flour to the dough to make that fun texture!

The churro covered generously in injeolmi soybean powder is my favorite.

Order one churro, sit on the bench under the big zelkova tree nearby, munch away, and feel Haenggung-dong's easy pace.

Naver Map

23 Dessert · Neighborhood

딩동 Dingdong

A hidden dessert powerhouse recognized by Haenggung-dong locals.

They use good ingredients and make things honestly, without tricks, trying to show dessert as dessert should be.

It is a shop loved by the village, one that locals keep returning to.

Drinks

24 Izakaya · Nihonshu

사케도로보 Sakedorobo

A motsunabe izakaya whose original recipe was approved by a Japanese daughter-in-law. You can enjoy a variety of nihonshu with it.

The motsunabe is good, but the Osaka-style okonomiyaki and tebasaki chicken wings are killer with beer, too!

Naver Map

25 Pub · Sea snails

유동골뱅이 Yudong Golbaengi

A big sea-snail place every Suwon person knows. This is another long-standing Nammun regular, operating in the same spot for nearly 30 years!

The white sea-snail soup is good, and the sea-snail cucumber salad is good too.

The small room has tables packed close together, so it is not quiet, but somehow it feels alive, full of the energy of daily life.

Naver Map

26 Traditional pub · Old school

산적 Sanjeok

A Haenggung-dong generation-0.5 traditional pub that existed before the neighborhood even had this name. Since then, its many snacks have kept drink lovers happy.

The most popular order is, no contest, the combination of "land-sea-air stir-fried udon + cheese potato pancake."

Add makgeolli or dongdongju and you get the proper old-school Haenggung-dong vibe.

Naver Map

To do

27 Independent bookstore

브로콜리숲 Broccoli Forest

A Haenggung-dong fixture of an independent bookstore. It has already been running for more than six years!

The owners love cats, so you may also meet the street cats loved around the alley.

Maybe because the owners came from the publishing world, they have a good eye for books and often host events with well-known writers.

Naver Map

28 Plants · Flower shop

서아샵 Seoa Shop

This may be the place where Nene has spent the most money...! It is our most-visited neighborhood plant shop. Almost all of our potted kids came from Seoa Shop... (whisper whisper)

We trust the talented owner's eye and often order bouquets as gifts. From 10,000-won bunches to large pots, you will be satisfied!

Nene likes buying flowers while traveling. It makes you feel a little local and gives a trip, which can sometimes go flat, a bit of life. Pick up that energy at Seoa Shop!

Naver Map

29 Jazz · Live

파닥파닥클럽 Padak Padak Club

In Suwon Haenggung-dong, you can enjoy live jazz every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evening!

You can check the set list on Instagram. We recommend booking through Naver before you go :)

Do not miss Padak Padak Club, a Haenggung-dong pride, where you can enjoy live music up close in a small space without pressure.
